title: 2017-11-10 -  Jamaica - IADB Loan for Energy Management and Efficiency Amendment
text:
## LEG/SGO/JA-EZSHARE-EZSHARE-1331705865-8720

Loan Contract No. 3877/OC-JA Amendatory Contract No. 1

## AMENDATORY CONTRACT NO. 1

AMENDATORY CONTRACT entered into between JAMAICA (the "Borrower") anc he INTER-AMERICAN DEVELOPMENT BANK (the "Bank", and together with th Borrower, the "Parties")

## ARTICLE ONE

The Parties agree to amend Loan Contract No. 3877/OC-JA (Energy Management and Efficiency Programme), entered into between the Borrower and the Bank on November 10, 2017 (the "Loan Contract"), in the manner and to the extent set forth below.

- Section 4.02 "Executing Agency" of the Special Conditions is amended in its entirety to read as follows:
- "SECTION 4.02. Executing Agency. (a) The Ministry of Science, Energy and Technology (MSET), acting on behalf of the Borrower, shall be the Executing Agency for the Programme."
2. Sub-section (a) of Section 7.02 "Communications and Notices" of the Special Conditions is amended in its entirety to read as follows:
- "SECTION 7.02. Communications and Notices. (a) Any notice, request, communication, or report from one Party to another by virtue of this Contract related to the execution of the Programme, with the exception of the notices indicated in paragraph (b) hereof, shall be made in writing and shall be considered to have been made when the relevant document is delivered to the addressee at the respective address given below, or by electronic means under such terms and conditions as the Bank establishes and communicates to the Borrower, unless the Parties agree otherwise.

For the Borrower:

Mailing address:

Ministry of Finance and the Public Service 30 National Heroes Circle Kingston 4 Jamaica, West Indies

Email address: finsec@mof.gov.jm

## For the Executing Agency:

## Mailing address:

Ministry of Science, Energy and Technology (MSET) PCJ Building, 36 Trafalgar Road, Kingston 10 Jamaica, West Indies

Facsimile: (876) 960-1623

Email address: info@mset.gov.jm

## For the Bank:

## Mailing address:

Inter-American Development Bank Country Office in Jamaica 6 Montrose Rd Kingston 6 Jamaica, West Indies

Facsimile: (876) 764-0852 / (876) 764-0853

Email address: idbjamaica@iadb.org

- Paragraph 4.01 of the Annex is amended in its entirety to read as follows:
- 4.01 The Ministry of Science, Energy and Technology (MSET) will be th 'xecuting Agency (EA) of the Proiect.

## ARTICLE TWO

The Parties hereby ratify that all other provisions of Loan Contract No. 3877/0C-JA, remain in full force and effect.

## ARTICLE THREE

The Parties agree that this Amendatory Contract No. 1 shall enter into force from the date of signature by the representative of the Borrower.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Borrower and the Bank, each acting through its authorized representative, have signed this Amendatory Contract No. 1 in two (2) equally valid copies.
